63:t_2:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$テッサ$$... I'm always causing you trouble. I'm sorry.」

63:t_2:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're an amazing girl. You're more than just my superior officer. Um... I think you're someone much more important to me.」

63:t_2:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「If anything happens, I'll be there for you. Just remember that...」

63:t_2:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「I-I'm sorry! That was t-t-too forward after all! But I meant it!」

63:t_2:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「Th-then I'll go ahead to where we're eating and save us seats!」

63:t_2:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$テッサ$$?! He called me $$テッサ$$! Oh, what do I do?!」

63:t_2:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Important to him... Oh, my! Oh, my!!」

63:t_2:68.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't just say my name. You were taking so long I came to get you, and then $$宗介$$ went dashing off...」

63:t_2:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It's nothing. Come on... Let's go have breakfast.」

63:t_2:70.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't really get it, but as long as you're feeling better, $$テッサ$$, that's fine with me. Shall we go?」

63:t_2:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
(You're so kind and strong, $$カナメ$$... I love you.)

63:t_2:72.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even if $$相良$$ doesn't choose me, it's all right... With what he said today, I can go on living.)

63:t_2:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
(As Captain $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$... As Empress of the Sea...)

63:t_2:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hey... I know you're worried, but spying on people is in bad taste.」

63:t_2:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「And you're grinning, too... It's creepy...」

63:t_2:77.en:
$n
「What are you talking about? Never mind the grinning, you were watching with me.」

63:t_2:78.en:
$n
「Or is it that, as $$ミスタートライアングラー$$, you're happy $$宗介$$ is about to join your club?」

63:t_2:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「You bastard...! You're torn between Nurse and Miss $$スズネ$$ yourself!」

63:t_2:82.en:
$n
「Uh... No... Um... I've never even... thought of Miss $$スズネ$$... that way...」

63:t_2:83.en:
$$アルト$$
「Well... Fine. You can tell me all about it over breakfast.」

63:t_2:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「You've given me plenty of grief about my love life. I'm not taking no for an answer, $n.」

63:t_2:90.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Come in, $$レド$$. It's a little cramped, though.」

63:t_2:92.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's my home. I live here with my little brother.」

63:t_2:94.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You don't know what a little brother is? A brother is a sibling. A younger sibling... Family.」

63:t_2:100.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Nice to meet you. I'm $$ベベル$$.」

63:t_2:101.en:
$$レド$$
(So this is... $$エイミー$$'s little brother...)

63:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were certainly fired up in last night's battle.」

63:t_10:6.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Y-yes... Fighting to protect civilians is a soldier's duty, after all.」

63:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now. Wasn't it because that was the kind of scenario you like?」

63:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no point hiding it. I just delivered those discs of a classic seafaring adventure anime to you the other day.」

63:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really got into it. When you faced that woman pirate, your excitement peaked enough to generate $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

63:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「100 Z in all...! I'll add those to the team's stock.」

63:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes, I know. Your anime hobby is a secret from everyone else, right?」

63:t_10:15.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's not it...! I'm placing my next order!」

63:t_10:16.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Seafaring adventures really are wonderful! I'll buy the complete disc set, rather than the abridged version!」

63:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your purchase! I look forward to you producing more high-quality $$Ｚチップ$$s like that!」

63:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$テッサ$$... Welcome to the $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

63:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've long been waiting for you to visit, $$テッサ$$. But toward the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, circumstances hardly allowed it...」

63:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now we find ourselves fighting together like this. I am deeply moved.」

63:t_10:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I see... You're rather more... polite than what everyone told me, $$ＡＧ$$...」

63:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is no need for respectful titles for this humble $$ＡＧ$$! Call me $$ＡＧ$$, or shitbug, or whatever you please!」

63:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, you are the ruler of these seas, $$テッサ$$... The invincible Empress!」

63:t_10:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Th-that was... part of the operation...」

63:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no. Commanding all those mighty warriors makes you truly worthy of the title of Empress!」

63:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll stop saying Empress and call you Princess instead!」

63:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$かなめ$$...! When did you get here?!」

63:t_10:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I heard $$テッサ$$ was coming to the hangar to welcome $$チェインバー#pilot$$. I was worried, so I came to check, and sure enough...!」

63:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, I'm terribly sorry... When I see a pretty girl, I just can't...」

63:t_10:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Let me tell you something. If you lay a hand on $$テッサ$$, you'll get more than a whack from my paper fan.」

63:t_10:41.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I have something to discuss with you. Come with me.」

63:t_10:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「And if you refuse, I have an appropriate response in mind.」
